question: On a fixed ten-coin OKX panel, does following the first EMA-aligned 12H close outside the completed NY Monday 1.618 band improve on the original V1.7 wick-and-close reclaim?
single_variable: Replace the V1.7 same-week first wick-through/reclaim close rule with a same-week first strict close beyond the upper/lower 1.618 band in the aligned EMA20/50 direction. Use next exact 1H open for both arms. Keep the fixed stop reference anchor, native EMA exit, nine-slot shared-cash account, and fees consistent.

data.venue: OKX USDT perpetual native 12H and 1H OHLC
data.candidate_bars: Complete native UTC 12H bars whose key-open and confirmation lie in the same New York Monday week, after a complete Monday 1H range, with V1.7 EMA20/EMA50 warmup complete. EMA state resets on any missing 12H bar.
data.monday_anchor: Rebuild per-symbol NY Monday 00:00-to-Tuesday 00:00 local-time extrema from exactly 24 observed H1 rows; upper = high + 0.618 * (high-low); lower = low - 0.618 * (high-low). Incomplete Monday is ineligible and never filled.
data.breakout_rule: Within each symbol/NY week, use only the first valid 12H close strictly above upper with EMA20>EMA50 (long) or strictly below lower with EMA20<EMA50 (short); long/short share one weekly signal lock. A qualifying signal without the exact next H1 open remains a no-entry event and still consumes that week's lock.
data.original_reclaim_comparator: Within each symbol/NY week, use the first native V1.7 reclaim from cloud_close_second_reclaim_paths._signal_at: long low<lower<close<upper and EMA20>EMA50; short lower<close<upper<high and EMA20<EMA50. This is rebuilt from native bars, not filtered from an already-funded parent list.
data.entry: Market at the exact H1 open whose UTC timestamp equals completed 12H confirmation; missing exact open or confirmation at/after account cutoff is no-entry.
data.stop: For breakout, use the actual crossed band as the source fixed_stop anchor: upper band for long and lower band for short. For the original reclaim comparator, retain the V1.7 touched-side anchor: lower band for long and upper band for short. Source fixed_stop(symbol, side, reference_anchor) keeps BTC/ETH 1.5% and others 3%; actual entry-to-stop distance is recomputed from the exact H1 open. Reject if the entry is not on the adverse side of its anchored stop.
data.original_exit: Use the existing V1.7 native 12H EMA-cross path callback and unchanged stop. First observed hourly gap open, earliest stale-12H observation, and true account/source tail close retain existing explicit exit behavior. No future completeness or outcome filtering.
data.data_quality: Retain actual source counts and 1H/12H gap counts per symbol. Inputs are already frozen OKX history; no downloads, gap filling, or post-cutoff H1 rows in path pricing.

controls.method: For each signal, sample one non-signal completed 12H confirmation from the same symbol, same NY week, same direction, and same EMA alignment, strictly after parent confirmation; require prior confirmed 12H ATR14/previous close within 25% relative difference.
controls.exclude_signal_bars: Exclude every bar that independently qualifies either the frozen breakout or original reclaim trigger.
controls.stop: Inherit the parent actual-entry-to-fixed-stop risk fraction at the control's exact next H1 open.
controls.without_replacement: One control per parent and without replacement within each arm/symbol/week.
controls.unmatched: Keep a corresponding explicit unmatched control row with reason. Never match to a confirmation at or before parent confirmation.

account.positions: One nine-slot shared-cash VectorBT account per arm and diagnostic scenario, fully collateralized and unlevered; at most one position per symbol. Entry priority is the existing wallet CRC32(symbol), symbol, event_id order. Existing open positions are not resized.
account.costs: OKX Lv1 taker 0.0005 each entry and market/stop/EMA exit. No limit exits. No extra slippage, funding, impact, maintenance-tier, or lot rounding in this experiment.
account.drawdown: Report VectorBT close/open NAV and synchronized conservative hourly intrabar upper drawdown bound; OHLC cannot establish exact within-hour high/low ordering.
account.trade_metrics: Report actual realized USDT payoff as well as equal-notional net-return payoff; wins and trade counts use closed funded positions within each period.

fees.maker_usage: No resting limit orders in either arm.

execution.path_engine: Existing VectorBT 1.2.0 Portfolio.from_order_func in cloud_close_reward_paths._simulate_symbol using the frozen V1.7 native order callback; independent one-unit path is only a fill price source.
execution.account_engine: Existing VectorBT 1.2.0 shared-cash account in cloud_close_reward_account.account, with actual finite slot/cash sizing.
execution.no_trade_engine: No hand-written bar-by-bar fill or PnL simulator; candidate construction is separate from VectorBT execution.
